name: The Hive Lord

abilities.name: Double Swipe
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Overhead Smash
abilities.description: An attack that dealing moderate-high physical damage, staggering and snaring all targets within the red cone in front of The Hive Lord. This attack can be difficult to dodge as it is very fast.

abilities.name: Defensive Instinct
abilities.description: The Hive Lord will pound the ground, dealing continuous direct moderate magic damage to all targets in a very large circle around it. This can be interrupted to stagger The Hive Lord.

abilities.name: Bounding Strike
abilities.description: The Hive Lord will randomly leap on a player, dealing moderate physical damage and stunning. The boss will only target players that are at a long distance from it, thus players may want to stay near the boss to avoid getting hit by this attack.

abilities.name: Summon Scribs
abilities.description: The Hive Lord will summon kwama scribs to assist it in battle, and thus they should be killed quickly. The scribs will emerge from the ground as indicated by a red circle, and any target standing on that area when the scribs emerge will be dealt moderate physical damage and staggered.

related_quests: Mine All Mine: Investigate a disturbance in Deshaan's largest kwama mine.
Pledge: Darkshade Caverns I: Explore Darkshade Caverns I and return Undaunted.
Darkshade Caverns Pledge: Explore Darkshade Caverns and return Undaunted. (disabled since Patch 2.6.4)
summary: The Hive Lord is a kwama warrior found in Darkshade Caverns I. It serves as an optional boss, and has a chance of dropping the Hive Lord's Shell.
